summary: Replicate's official 'Try for Free' collection page is live and states you can run the listed models without purchasing credit once you have a Replicate account. The FAQ clarifies the free usage is a limited number of runs per model; once the limit is hit, billing/credit purchase is required to continue. No fixed end date is published, so the offer appears ongoing. Terms match the offer claim exactly.
claim_steps: Create a Replicate account (free runs require being signed in).
Go to the Try for Free collection page at replicate.com/collections/try-for-free.
Select a model that matches your task (e.g. google/imagen-4 for images, minimax/video-01 for video).
Upload your input (text, image, or video) or provide a URL if required.
Run the model and review the output.
If it works for your needs, add a credit card and purchase credit to continue using the model beyond the free limit.

social_proof.title: Try free AI models to generate images, videos, and more - Replicate
social_proof.text: The Try for Free collection is our list of models that you can run without purchasing credit after creating a Replicate account. This is great to see if Replicate will work for your use case before spending money.
